responsibility: Specializes the generic AIX rs6000 configuration for AIX 4.3. It adds option-override diagnostics and fixes for 64-bit mode, soft-float versus long-double-128, assembler CPU mapping/specs, AIX 4.3 predefined macros and start/link/library specs, target defaults such as the default processor, and ABI details like ptrdiff_t and deferred .set output needed for this OS release.
